## Summary

Eliminates the errors, warnings, false positives, and false negatives found in the failing default-branch CI run, and reconciles Hive Mind's complete CI/CD surface with the JavaScript pipeline template and `docs/CI-CD-BEST-PRACTICES.md`.

The change:

1. restores every Node 24 runtime-loaded command with immutable package versions and safe CommonJS namespace normalization;
2. safely migrates old `use-m` aliases whose package executables collide with pinned aliases;
3. makes help, global-command, log, and dry-run smoke checks reject real startup/runtime errors;
4. adds a terminal pipeline result gate so failed and timeout-cancelled jobs cannot be hidden;
5. adds CodeQL and high-severity dependency review with least-privilege permissions;
6. removes Git/action-runtime/install/audit warnings and all 19 file-headroom warnings; and
7. preserves the complete investigation, raw CI logs, reproductions, and verification artifacts under `dev/log/issues/2150/pulls/2151`.

## Root causes

- `command-stream@0.19.0` was published 141 minutes before the failing run. `use-m@8.15.0` resolved that mutable `latest` version and returned Node 24's CommonJS namespace object without unwrapping it, making the shared `$` command export undefined. Node 20 and `command-stream@0.18.0` isolate the failure as controls.
- The memory `--help` test accepted stderr/nonzero execution as output, while several smoke paths used `|| true` or conflated expected timeout status with arbitrary failure.
- `timeout-minutes` produces a cancelled job and the workflow had no final observer, so main-branch timeouts could be indistinguishable from a superseded PR run.
- Checkout was initialized before Git warning suppression, old JavaScript action bundles emitted runtime warnings, vulnerable transitive packages remained locked, and npm's script-review policy lacked an explicit decision.
- Nineteen files had reached the 1,350-line warning threshold even though they remained below the 1,500-line hard failure limit.

## Implementation

- Pin all eight bare `use-m` dependencies at one loader boundary and in the CI preinstaller; pin both bootstrap CDNs to `use-m@8.15.0`.
- Normalize only the distinctive Node namespace shape where `default === module.exports`, validate `$` as callable, and retain opt-in `HIVE_MIND_USE_M_DEBUG` / `PREINSTALL_USE_M_VERBOSE` diagnostics (off by default).
- Recover npm alias executable conflicts only after verifying that the conflicting symlink belongs to another `use-m` alias of the same package; unrelated paths are refused.
- Require exact command exit/output contracts and use a deterministic invalid-URL fixture for log verification.
- Add `pipeline-status`, `security.yml`, current v6 checkout/setup actions, pre-checkout Git configuration, exact-version install-script approval, and zero-vulnerability lockfile resolutions.
- Enable the repository Dependency Graph through GitHub's documented vulnerability-alerts endpoint after the first hosted Dependency Review exposed that missing prerequisite; rerun the unchanged gate successfully rather than suppressing it.
- Extract Claude connection handling, GitHub URL parsing, and solve tool loading into tested modules; mechanically compact the remaining warning-only files without changing their AST or template-literal values.
- Add the required patch Changeset.

## Reproduction and regression coverage

Failing-before evidence is retained for the Node 24 loader, callable-export validation, memory help false positive, alias executable collision, CI integrity gaps, security workflow absence, and nondeterministic log smoke. Corresponding automated tests pass after the implementation.

The full evidence-backed timeline, requirement-by-requirement disposition, root-cause matrix, template comparison, upstream research, alternatives, and verification map are in [`ANALYSIS.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2150-199d187a22bb/dev/log/issues/2150/pulls/2151/ANALYSIS.md).

Two novel loader defects were reported upstream with minimal reproducers, workarounds, and proposed code fixes:

- [`use-m` #72: Node 23+ CommonJS namespace marker prevents default-export unwrapping](https://github.com/link-foundation/use-m/issues/72)
- [`use-m` #73: version aliases with the same package bin fail with EEXIST](https://github.com/link-foundation/use-m/issues/73)

Matching template defects were already tracked by template issues #41, #99, #123, and #126, so no duplicates were opened.

## Verification

- `npm test` — all 385 selected test files passed
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run format:check`
- `npm run check:duplication` — 9.5%, below the 11% gate
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh` — no warning; `release.yml` is 1,327 lines
- all MJS and changed shell syntax checks
- all three workflows parse as YAML
- clean Node 24 `npm ci` — no install warning
- `npm audit --json` — zero vulnerabilities
- strict global command and deterministic log smoke tests
- real preinstallation of all eight pinned aliases
- [Security run 31514274130](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/31514274130), attempt 2 — Dependency Review and both CodeQL languages passed
- [Checks and release run 31514274046](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/31514274046) — every substantive job and the terminal Pipeline Status gate passed on code SHA `023586b2`

Fixes #2150
title: fix(ci): eliminate false results and warnings
